pipe.step1.name: Collect
pipe.step1.desc: Federal bills and rules (GovInfo, Federal Register) plus 50 state legislatures ({from}–{to} in this database); full text
pipe.step2.name: Classify
pipe.step2.desc: Skip ceremonial, memorial and naming bills; split long federal bills into chapters
pipe.step3.name: Extract
pipe.step3.desc: An LLM reads each bill or chapter and flags RD, DiD, both or none; schema-validated
pipe.step4.name: Score
pipe.step4.desc: Composite of identification, significance, intensity and data feasibility; hard caps
pipe.step5.name: Screen
pipe.step5.desc: Strictly enacted, no 3‑state wave, non‑COVID, open data, weakest sub-score ≥3
